title: Abreu–Diwan–Jackson–Labbate–Sheehan constituent conjecture for pseudo 2-factors
statement: Let $G$ be an essentially $4$-edge-connected pseudo $2$-factor isomorphic cubic bipartite graph, where essentially $4$-edge-connected means 3-edge-connected with no non-trivial 3-edge-cuts. **Abreu–Diwan–Jackson–Labbate–Sheehan's constituent conjecture.** Then $G\in\{K_{3,3},H_0,P_0\}$. This is one of the two constituent statements whose validity is equivalent in the survey to the preceding 3-edge-connected classification conjecture.
source_name: D. Labbate and F. Romaniello, “An updated survey on 2-Factors of Regular Graphs”, arXiv:2408.04642 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04642

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2024).
